manifest.name: @suxeca/dsh-literature-library
manifest.description: Authenticated persistent literature bookmarks and local research library for the radar briefing.

bundle.text:
# Bundle patch for @suxeca/dsh-literature-library
#
# No paths are declared here on purpose: an absolute path in a published bundle
# patch pins the plugin to the machine that built it. The plugin resolves its
# three paths at activation instead, in this order:
#
#   1. the libraryRoot / catalogPath / pagePath config keys, or the
#      DSH_LITERATURE_ROOT environment variable for the whole root
#   2. ~/Workspace/docs/literature, when that directory already exists
#   3. ~/.dsh/literature (portable default)
#
# Derived from the root: <root>/library, <root>/library/catalog.json,
# <root>/library-page.html. Override explicitly like this if your layout differs:
#
#   config:
#     libraryRoot: /srv/literature/library
#     catalogPath: /srv/literature/library/catalog.json
#     pagePath: /srv/literature/library-page.html
- insert:
    - id: literature-library
      name: '@suxeca/dsh-literature-library'
      config: {}
